    T2. Forward-looking reporting short-term risks (next few weeks/months) [YES] — Fed meeting next week, CPI release same day, rate hike expectations

Synopsis:
    Gold is on track for a third straight weekly loss, down over 2% on the week, as market expectations shift toward a Fed rate hike at the upcoming meeting. A hotter-than-expected August PPI print (+0.4%) has traders increasing bets on tightening. A key CPI release is due the same day. Geopolitical risk from Houthi advances in Yemen and Iran tensions are adding inflationary pressure via oil (both benchmarks heading above $100/bbl for the first time since mid-May), though rising rates are the dominant headwind for gold. Silver, platinum, and palladium are also posting weekly losses.
